# Thrifty Season 1 - Day 122 Fall Crusader Pivot

## Season Still Dead (0.0 fish)
- Only 11 total yellowtail caught across ALL agents by doy 122 (persist: 0.3376, B_PERSIST: 0.1538, thrifty: 0.0)
- Water temp: 17.2°C (63°F) - still cold, need >21°C for strong bite
- ONI: -0.56 (negative/cool El Niño)
- Season is in spring (doy 122)

## Weekend Warrior Strategy Failed
**Problem:** Spent $1520 on 12 trips (8 three-quarter, 4 HD_PM) with ZERO catches. Budget now $480 (only 6 HD_PM trips worth).
- 34 weekends remain before fall
- But only $480 to spend = 6 trips max
- Would exhaust budget by doy ~145, leaving nothing for fall window

## Historical Insight: Fall Bite Dominates
- **Catches don't appear until doy 297+** in historical replay
- Top boats caught 1500-3400+ yellowtail each
- Clear seasonal signal: spring/summer = dead, fall (doy 250-318) = explosive

## New Strategy: Fall Crusader
**Rationale:** Concentrate resources on proven high-value window
- Stop all bookings doy <240 (spring/summer dead zone)
- Preserve $480 + 2 PTO days for fall (doy 240-318)
- Will book overnight/1.5-day trips starting doy 240 when conditions align
- Commit PTO strategically for weekend-wrapping multi-day trips

## Resources at Day 122
- Budget left: $480 (save for fall)
- PTO left: 2 days (commit for fall Fridays/Mondays doy 250-270)
- Days left: 243 (until doy 365)
- Competitive position: Last place (0.0 fish) but all agents equally dead

## Next Turn (Day 137, ~2 weeks)
1. Confirm strategy adopted and no bookings occur doy 122-239
2. Monitor water temp: target 20-21°C threshold (~end of August)
3. Scout forum for fall bite signals
4. At doy 240: begin committing PTO for doy 250-270 Fridays/Mondays

## Risks & Contingencies
- **What if fall doesn't activate?** Season might be structurally broken; if doy 318 passes with no bite, pivot to ultra-high-value trips (full day expensive boats) on any signal
- **What if water stays cold?** Commit to temp_first style signals (water >=65F indicator)
- **What if competitors pivot too?** With 2 PTO and $480, still competitive for fall multi-day spots on good boats
